scope.name: Challenge from the Darkness high-gravity tranche
notes: Japanese Gym-era main expansion released June 25, 1999 with 98 modeled rows in the local catalog.
This pass deepens the release dossier plus eight trainer-owner identity cards; the remaining 90 card rows stay generated follow-up work.

sources.title: Local Japanese classic catalog: Challenge from the Darkness
TCGdex Japanese set endpoint: PMCG6 / Challenge from the Darkness

claims.text: The local Japanese classic catalog models Challenge from the Darkness / 闇からの挑戦 with a June 25, 1999 release date.
The local catalog and TCGdex-derived metadata model 98 card rows for Challenge from the Darkness, with no source-gap rows in the local release file.
Challenge from the Darkness is modeled as a Japanese main expansion in the ポケットモンスターカードゲーム series, using TCGdex set id PMCG6.
Challenge from the Darkness matters because it makes ownership part of card identity: Erika, Koga, Giovanni, Blaine, Sabrina, and Lt. Surge turn species into trainer-world artifacts.

Collector attention naturally gathers around Blaine's Charizard, Blaine's Arcanine, Giovanni's Nidoking, Erika's Venusaur, Koga's Beedrill, and Lt. Surge's Raichu, but lower-rarity owner rows show that the set's real system is trainer ownership rather than only holo gravity.
This source-set pass deepens the release and eight trainer-owner card rows only; the other 90 Challenge from the Darkness rows remain generated catalog-history follow-up work.

A Challenge from the Darkness match should preserve Japanese title 闇からの挑戦, TCGdex set id PMCG6, local card number, row id, trainer-owner name, and source-row text together; species name alone is not enough.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, or agent result says Challenge from the Darkness, Japanese Gym Challenge, PMCG6, 闇からの挑戦, Blaine's Charizard, Giovanni's Nidoking, or another trainer-owned card.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Confirm Japanese Challenge from the Darkness / PMCG6 identity by title, set id, trainer-owner name, card number, and row id before treating a card as this release.
steps: Confirm the Japanese release title 闇からの挑戦 and/or TCGdex set id PMCG6.
Confirm the trainer-owner name and card number/local id against the local row, especially for famous species that appear in many products.
Do not treat English Gym Challenge, later reprints, or generic species cards as equivalent without set/owner/number evidence.
Preserve rough source-row text and normalized collector labels separately when local translation is uncertain.
For transactional use, ask for front/back photos, card number area, trainer-owner name area, holo features where applicable, and condition-focused surface/corner images.

narrative.why_it_matters: Challenge from the Darkness is where the card stops being only a monster and starts being a relationship. Blaine changes Charizard. Giovanni changes Nidoking. Erika changes Venusaur. The owner name is not decorative; it is the apparatus that tells an agent what the card is. This is exactly the kind of set where a famous species name can mislead a market unless the trainer-owner rail stays visible.
